annotations.title: URL to Markdown: Clean Page Text for LLMs and RAG

description: Fetch a public web page and return its main text as Markdown with title, headings, lists, tables and absolute links. Respects robots.txt, refuses private and internal addresses, no JavaScript rendering. For pages that need a browser, use a rendering tool. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).
name: url_to_markdown
title: URL to Markdown: Clean Page Text for LLMs and RAG
